chassis.name: BERT Tester
chassis.about: Bit error rate tester: sends a test pattern out of a port's Tx and counts the errors in what comes back into its Rx. Fiber its ports to client ports.

linecards.name: BERT Tester
linecards.about: Two 100GE test ports, each a QSFP28 cage with its own Tx and Rx. Put in the same LR4 optics as the client port it is fibered to.
